limitations: No classification of all plane quartics, no distribution of the other 28 minus rational geometric bitangents, and no independent external replication. Priority overlap with unindexed earlier computational data is possible.
scientific_integrity: An exhaustive deterministic calculation of all 800 smooth scalar-normalized six-monomial equations and their 31 rational lines, with two mathematically distinct exact verifiers; the geometric smoothness and square-root criteria are separately proved. This is a complete census in marked coordinates, not a classification of abstract isomorphism classes.
title: Rational bitangent-contact spectrum of smooth Ciani quartics over \(\mathbb F_5\)
